classInit is the literal construction bridge (_ZN10dFdDummy_cC1Ev is dFdDummy_c's out-of-line constructor, so `return new dScDSMT_c()` would inline a different fader constructor), storing the vptr addresses through their data_ov007_021032e8 / data_ov007_021032b0 aliases of _ZTV9dScDSMT_c and _ZTVN9dScDSMT_c15graphCallback_cE (see the symbolRename note) -- this TU emits both vtables. ov007's _ZTV rows sit AT the vtable address point (0x021032e8 = slot 0 InitResources), so the address-point spelling is plain `_ZTV`, not the `&_ZTV[2]` storage-start convention other modules use.

The five wrappers func_ov007_020cca68..020ccab4 are `bx ip` sibcall veneers under -interworking: Deallocate/LoadFile through #pragma long_calls' pooled branch, and Heap::Allocate/_Deallocate/MaxAllocationUnitSize member calls on the game heap at data_020a0ea0. func_ov007_020cca68's Deallocate signature is decl_common.h's `void Deallocate(void*)`, so the veneer takes and forwards `void *p` -- the arg lands in r0 either way and the tail branch is identical.

Declaration reconciliations recorded on the previous revision still stand: data_0209b340 stays decl_common.h's `int[]` with byte-view casts in func_ov007_020cc168; data_0209caa0 stays `int[]` (the dispatcher's trailing `data_0209caa0[0x328]` byte read is spelt ((u8*)data_0209caa0)[0x328]); data_0209b33c is `FileSaveData *` (the dispatcher needs flags1, so the opaque `struct E` gave way to the recovered 0x44 layout already used by the pre-fold file); func_ov007_020b7090 takes (u16,u16,u16,u16,int).

overlay_100/overlay_102 remain two of the pre-existing `dsd check symbols` errors (absolute ARM9-main rows at 0x64/0x66 outside every module's sections) -- baseline errors, unchanged by this fold.
